negative_results.statement: Typed-IR semantic equivalence alone cannot select the ClayCode relation surface: declared-bare, disjoint-sigil and generic-call arms all satisfied the tested canonical Relation IR/hash oracle.
negative_results.evidence: 4/4 matched cases hash-identical across all three arms; 3000/3000 whitespace variants per arm stable; unknown relation rejected in all arms.
negative_results.implication: Surface freeze must use additional production measurements: full-corpus closure, diagnostics, mutation survival, migration edits, token/context cost, reader repair, parser/compiler complexity and latency.

negative_results.statement: A successful micro surface->typed-IR oracle is insufficient to claim CC-WP-02, CC-WP-03, BASE, or general-purpose gate PASS.
negative_results.evidence: The experiment does not cover the complete 86-chunk G9+dialect corpus, the production-bound parser, target Ubuntu runtime, type/effect checking, lowering or application acceptance suite.
negative_results.implication: Keep all release workspace work packages and application acceptance states unchanged.
